native_matrix.role: Post-hoc Discovery / previously examined, mutually overlapping backtests
native_matrix.units: Arithmetic mean of original four-decimal r_result telemetry per closed trade (price R).
native_matrix.derivation: Each cell is counted and Decimal-summed directly from its original archived trades.csv. Means divide that sum by its row count; no grid reconstructed from narrative totals.
native_matrix.costs: Fill-price-derived telemetry; commission, financing, account-risk and historical broker/session parity are not established by price R.
native_matrix.implementation: Legacy MT5 baseline A; fixed 0.01 lot; real-tick Model 4; SignalTF equals tester Period in every qualified cell.
limitations: Not a portfolio: jobs overlap and share no synchronized capital or occupancy model.
No fresh OOS, selection-corrected alpha or deployability claim.
M1, M5 and D1 are absent from this R2 matrix.
Reported audit: 74 nonpositive initial-risk denominators assigned zero R; 7,790 exact-zero R records; moved_to_be telemetry defective.
Price-R observations can have extreme tails; displayed arithmetic means retain all source outcomes.
native_matrix.decision: Discovery matrix complete; no broad transportable edge. Frozen prior candidates unchanged.

policy_matrix.decision: AMBIGUITY_SENSITIVE / PARK all four cells; no winner selected.
policy_matrix.units: Closed-trade counts and original price-space R; PF from price R.
policy_matrix.costs: Executable Bid/Ask side represented, including adverse stop gaps. Full commission, financing and account-risk economics are not established.

pending_contract.PENDING_GTC_BLOCK: One good-till-cancelled pending order blocks later signals; no time expiry.
pending_contract.PENDING_REPLACE_ON_NEW_SIGNAL: Check active-position eligibility first. A non-BE_APPLIED position blocks replacement. Otherwise supersede old pending and create the new signal order; no time expiry.

be_contract.BE_COMPLETED_H4_POST_ENTRY: A fully post-entry completed H4 candle must exceed the signal high/low in the trade direction.
be_contract.BE_INTRABAR_H4_EXTREME_POST_ENTRY: A later post-entry Bid tick must exceed the signal high/low in the trade direction.
be_contract.common: BE arms until executable; only applied BE permits stacking; executable-side stop fills; deterministic target-level exits; no pre-fill confirmation.

limitations: Separate Python contracts, not pooled confirmations of the native MT5 strategy.
Three-trade GTC arms fail exposure/stability gates despite positive price R.
No new backtest, holdout, optimization or source-author interpretation selection.

small_candle.role: Retrospective observational diagnosis on spent Discovery, 2020–2023
small_candle.interval_method: Post-selection exploratory; not selection-adjusted. 20,000 stratified signal-calendar-month block-bootstrap valid replicates; percentile 2.5/97.5; seed 20261011; frozen quartiles retained.
small_candle.contrast: Rank all placed opportunities within each symbol-year by engulf range / causal ATR. Contrast filled Q1 mean original r_result minus filled Q4 mean; average the 12 strata equally.
small_candle.units: Difference in original price R per filled trade; smaller minus larger relative-range quartile.
small_candle.costs: Original price-R outcomes, not commission/financing/account-risk net economics. No second spread subtraction.
small_candle.decision: CONSISTENT_NEGATIVE_ASSOCIATION; parent Anti-EBP program PARKED for priority; reversal and stop interventions unrun.
limitations: Observational and conditioned on fills; no causal stop-width or profitable reversal conclusion.
XAUUSD2 excluded for unresolved at-test history identity.
Symbol/year intervals unavailable; only the registered aggregate has the reported 95% interval.
